lines.1: We decide to take a slight detour on our way to the faculty room where Inori is.
lines.4: 「The first chemistry laboratory preparation room, then.」
lines.6: 「(Tsushima... To think he would show me around so carefully...)」
lines.8: She's gazing vacantly out the window at the sky.
lines.9: 「Oh, if it isn't Tsushima and Tachibana. Is something the matter?」
lines.10: 「It's time for closing homeroom. You still hadn't come, so we came to fetch you.」
lines.11: 「I completely forgot. The clouds were so extraordinarily creative in form that I became captivated.」
lines.13: 「Incidentally, that long vertical cloud looks like a nail-studded bat to me. The cloud beside it looks like a cruise missile.」
lines.14: 「You've got quite the imagination, Ms. Inori. That's wild.」
lines.15: 「I've heard Inori once considered becoming an art teacher. Something creative like that gives her unique sensibilities quite the jolt.」
lines.16: Come to think of it, I feel like I've heard that before. Anyway, it's probably for the best that she didn't become one.
lines.17: 「Forget the clouds, Ms. Inori. Let's go to class.」
lines.18: 「That's right. Then shall we head to the classroom?」
lines.20: Inori walks slowly, but thanks to that, I get to walk beside Tachibana a little longer. I ought to be grateful.
lines.22: When I notice, Tachibana is staring intently at my face.
lines.28: 「So green. The scent of green youth is everywhere.」
